fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami police scandals and oversight of the police department, reporting arrests connected to alleged gambling and grand jury leaks. Political coverage discusses Florida primary contests and local county offices, including candidate announcements and factional disputes. Local business and civic news includes discussion of Coral Gables Corporation refinancing and other Greater Miami economic concerns. The issue also contains community columns, letters to the editor, legal notices, and coverage of public events such as the Miami beauty contest at Bayfront Park and the Dade County Fair, alongside advertisements.
